metric_definitions.embedding_collapse_score: Legacy key: (mean pairwise item-embedding cosine + 1)/2. Measures directional similarity, not proof of collapse or recommendation diversity. Null when fewer than two items can be sampled.
metric_definitions.embedding_sample_count: Number of non-padding item embeddings sampled.
metric_definitions.embedding_pair_count: Number of distinct unordered sampled embedding pairs.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_valid_sample_count: Number of sampled training positions with positive != 0; repeated positions may occur.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean positive minus negative logit on sampled training positions; null if empty.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_p10: Nearest-rank 10th percentile of sampled training margins; null if empty.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction of sampled training margins below zero; null if empty.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction of sampled training margins below 0.5; scale dependent; null if empty.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_category_breakdown: Counts low-margin and wrong-rank training positions. Category lists remain empty because item categories are unavailable. These are training diagnostics, not held-out accuracy.
